mintAuthority.summary: MAI is minted natively on 14 reviewed non-Fraxtal QiDao deployments by borrowing against overcollateralized vault positions under owner-set debt ceilings. Polygon and Base are currently identified by QiDao as fully live; the other nonzero-supply deployments remain legacy native issuance surfaces whose current ability to accept new issuance is not independently established. Per-chain MAI owner Safes can authorize or revoke native mint paths and change issuance parameters; the Polygon collateral vaults are owned by a separate 3-of-4 QiDao Safe that sets per-vault ceilings. Fraxtal is a reviewed native deployment but is sunset with ownership renounced and zero supply. No current tracked deployment is classified as a bridge representation.

controls.label: QiDao vault/minter contracts
controls.capDescription: MAI is minted by borrowers against overcollateralized vaults under per-vault ceilings, AND directly by the per-chain MAI token owner Safes: every reviewed MAI token contract also exposes an owner-gated mint(address,uint256) with no collateral and no debt-ceiling check (Polygon 0xa3fa99 'QiStablecoin': mint/burn(address,uint256) external onlyOwner; Ethereum/Arbitrum/Optimism/Base/Gnosis/Metis/Kava/zkEVM/BSC/Linea 'EditableERC20': mint onlyOwner; Fantom AnyswapV4ERC20 owner-mint).
controls.evidence: QiDao docs describe borrowers minting MAI against overcollateralized vault positions and repaying or being liquidated per market rules across supported chains. Verified on Polygon at block 90573828: the MAI token 0xa3fa99a148fa48d14ed51d610c367c61876997f1 exposes debtCeiling() = getDebtCeiling() = 206,000,000e18 and owner() = the reviewed 3-of-5 Safe 0x3feacf904b152b1880bde8bf04ac9eb636fee4d8, while totalSupply() reads 305,129,005.936e18, so the token-level ceiling parameter does not currently bound observed Polygon supply and the binding limits are the per-vault ones. Individual collateral vaults are separate contracts with their own ceilings: camWMATIC vault 0x88d84a85A87ED12B8f098e8953B322fF789fCD1a returns getDebtCeiling() = 71,929.158e18 and _minimumCollateralPercentage() = 10000, and WETH vault 0x3fd939B017b31eaADF9ae50C7fF7Fa5c0661d47C returns getDebtCeiling() = 248,572.676e18 and _minimumCollateralPercentage() = 591 (raw contract integers, not normalized here). No vault or token entry point lets the minting path change its own ceiling: the camWMATIC vault's owner() is Gnosis Safe 0x1d8a6b7941ef1349c1b5e378783cd56b001ecfbc (v1.3.0, 3-of-4 owners 0x22cFAE74, 0x86fE8d6D, 0xbFEF4Bf4, 0xa475aF18, no enabled modules, zero guard, master copy 0x3e5c63644e683549055b9be8653de26e0b4cd36e) and the WETH vault's owner() is administration contract 0x257ff75bef85ca0c1517168ef27efc69e5c7016f, whose own owner() is that same Safe. Cap raising therefore always terminates in a QiDao admin multisig, never in the mint execution surface.

controls.label: QiDao native vault/minter mechanics (other reviewed deployments)
controls.capDescription: QiDao's native deployments use the same borrower-collateralized vault path: vault contracts enforce debt ceilings, collateral ratios and the configured oracle before transferring newly minted MAI. The vault execution surface cannot raise its own ceiling; owner-controlled token and vault administration remains a separate native issuance control.
controls.evidence: QiDao's official chain-risk documentation states that each deployment operates as a separate protocol on its blockchain, users mint and repay MAI against collateral on that chain, and only the protocol, not a bridge, can mint MAI. The official erc20Stablecoin source enforces the debt-ceiling and collateral-ratio checks in borrowToken(). This control covers the reviewed native routes other than the separately evidenced Polygon vault sample and excludes the sunset Fraxtal deployment.

controls.label: QiDao vault-admin Safe (Polygon vault owner, 3/4)
controls.capDescription: Owns the Polygon QiDao collateral vaults directly or through administration contract 0x257ff75bef85ca0c1517168ef27efc69e5c7016f, so it sets per-vault debt ceilings, minimum collateral percentages and gain ratios. It does not itself mint MAI.
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 90573828 direct Safe reads returned VERSION() = 1.3.0, getThreshold() = 3, getOwners() = the four listed signers, getModulesPaginated(SENTINEL, 10) = an empty module array, guard storage slot 0x4a204f62... = zero and master-copy slot 0 = 0x3e5c63644e683549055b9be8653de26e0b4cd36e. camWMATIC vault 0x88d84a85A87ED12B8f098e8953B322fF789fCD1a owner() returns this Safe; WETH vault 0x3fd939B017b31eaADF9ae50C7fF7Fa5c0661d47C owner() returns 0x257ff75bef85ca0c1517168ef27efc69e5c7016f whose owner() is this Safe. Three of its four signers (0x22cFAE74, 0xbFEF4Bf4, 0xa475aF18) also sign the reviewed 3-of-5 Polygon token-owner Safe, so the vault-admin and token-owner surfaces are a shared common mode rather than independent controls.

controls.evidence: At Polygon block 88276735, owner() on MAI token returned 0x3feacf904...; getOwners() = 5 signers; getThreshold() = 3; getModulesPaginated() returned empty (no modules). Safe confirmed.

review.evidence: MAI has 15 authored chain-local deployments, of which 14 remain non-Fraxtal native issuance surfaces and Fraxtal is sunset. Current owner reads on 2026-08-16 returned the reviewed issuer Safe domains: Polygon 3/5 at block 92145284, Ethereum 4/6 at block 25770921, Arbitrum 2/4 at block 495296480, Optimism 2/4 at block 155662088, Base 4/6 at block 50066803, Avalanche 2/4 at block 92982965, Gnosis 4/6 at block 47762426, Metis 4/6 at block 23043283, Kava 4/6 at block 22136771, BSC 2/4 at block 116360515, and Linea 2/4 at block 31737844. Fantom and Moonbeam current provider reads were unavailable, so their latest successful 2026-07-20 observations remain 2/3 at block 122578793 and 4/6 at block 16514101; Polygon zkEVM's latest available response is stale at block 33391890 from 2026-07-03 and reports 2/4. These are chain-local native issuer owners, not bridge controllers; fixed-block Safe reads establish two enabled Optimism modules and no Base modules with a zero guard, while module/guard state remains unresolved for the remaining newly covered long-tail chains. QiDao's official chain-risk documentation describes independent per-chain native minting, and the official erc20Stablecoin source enforces debt-ceiling and collateral-ratio checks in borrowToken(). masterMinter()/MINTER_ROLE both revert on the primary sampled chains, owner-only mint pattern. 2026-07-20 cur-8 extension (Polygon block 90573828): the vault/minter surface was resolved from on-chain reads. MAI token debtCeiling() = 206,000,000e18 under token-owner Safe 0x3feacf90 against a totalSupply() of 305,129,005.936e18, so the binding limits are the per-vault ceilings; collateral vaults are separate cap-limited contracts (camWMATIC and WETH sampled) whose owner() chain terminates in Gnosis Safe 0x1d8a6b7941ef1349c1b5e378783cd56b001ecfbc (v1.3.0, 3-of-4, no modules, zero guard), directly or via administration contract 0x257ff75bef85ca0c1517168ef27efc69e5c7016f. No mint entry point can raise its own ceiling, so cap raising is a separate multisig control. Three of the vault-admin signers also sign the Polygon token-owner Safe. Economic-posture fields remain partially-bounded-admin/unbounded: overlapping QiDao Safes can raise vault ceilings or replace authorized mint paths, while issuance remains on-chain collateral-gated with no named supervisor or attestor. Polygon and Base are currently described by QiDao as fully live; legacy nonzero-supply deployments are not assumed to accept new issuance; Fraxtal owner is renounced and total supply is zero.
